hero.subheading: Trendy is your AI assistant for building brands: market analysis, visual identity, and ready-to-publish marketing content — it speaks your language and understands your market, in minutes, not months.
hero.phoneField1Placeholder: e.g., specialty coffee with Levantine flavors

why.heading: Built to save you three things
why.subheading: Time, cost, and confusion. Every feature on the platform is designed to serve these three goals.
why.body1: No need to hire a separate market researcher, brand designer, and content writer. Trendy combines them into one AI assistant for a simple subscription cost.
why.body2: The branding journey that usually takes weeks of meetings and revisions becomes a smart, streamlined pipeline completed in a single session.
why.body3: Competitor reports, market trends, and real SWOT analysis before you spend a single dollar on marketing or design.

studio.heading: Ready-to-publish content, whenever you need it
studio.subheading: Once your identity is complete, the Content Creator becomes a permanent part of your dashboard — request a new post anytime, and it automatically reads your saved identity to keep everything consistent.
studio.feature1Body: Every request from the Content Studio is independent and repeatable without limits, with no need to redo any previous step.
studio.feature2Body: Image dimensions are automatically adjusted to fit every platform — Instagram, Facebook, and more — without any manual work.
studio.feature3Body: Save or download any post instantly (as text or image) to use right away outside the platform.

trial.heading: Try your brand before you pay anything
trial.subheading: Start without entering payment details. Track your project's progress directly from your email, and review each stage at your own pace.
trial.step1Title: Start with just your idea and email
trial.step1Body: No complicated sign-up, no credit card.
trial.step2Body: A stage summary and a direct link to review or request changes.
trial.step3Body: Review from your inbox without needing to repeatedly log into the dashboard.
trial.formSubheading: Enter your email and a quick description of your idea, and we'll send you your first market analysis report within minutes.
trial.ideaPlaceholder: Your idea in one sentence (e.g., specialty coffee with Levantine flavors)

audiences.heading: Wherever you're starting from
audiences.subheading: Whether you have just an idea, a small project, or an existing brand — we have a path that fits you.
audiences.audience1Body: You have a product idea and need to build a fast, affordable brand without deep marketing expertise.
audiences.audience2Body: You want to refresh your current identity or continuously produce professional content through the Content Studio.
audiences.audience3Body: Already have a logo and colors? Import them directly and benefit from market analysis and content without generating a new identity from scratch.

cta.heading: Your next brand starts with a single idea
cta.subheading: Join Trendy and turn your idea into a complete brand package — strategy, identity, and content — with the least time and effort possible.

footer.tagline: A comprehensive AI platform for building and managing brands, from the first idea to ready-to-publish content.
